_comment: Names the voice gets wrong, and how to spell them so it gets them right.
Pass with --lexicon. Copy this to lexicon.json and add entries as you find them.
RESPELLINGS, NOT PHONEMES. ElevenLabs' docs: 'Pronunciation dictionary phoneme
tags only work with eleven_flash_v2 and eleven_v3 models. Other models skip
dictionary phoneme tags and use the default pronunciation.' The channel runs on
eleven_multilingual_v2, so an IPA string here would be silently ignored — no
error, same wrong reading. Write how it should be SPELLED to sound right.
Substitution is whole-word, so a 'Hiero' entry cannot corrupt 'hierarchy', and
it applies only to the text sent to the API — the read-check and the mastering
alignment still see the real spelling.
